Measured the live cypress-rwa surface; the journey cannot pass because the generic live-backend path never wired the SPA-to-backend origin: backend CORS allows only http://localhost:${REACT_APP_PORT} but the runner serves the SPA from http://127.0.0.1:, so all credentialed XHR are CORS-rejected. + backend env REACT_APP_PORT=

open_questions:
SERVING GAP (both lanes): real-app-run.ts executeRun must serve/address the SPA as http://localhost:

and inject REACT_APP_PORT=

into backend.env so CORS matches; needs static-before-backend ordering + a localhost origin from startStaticServer (binds 127.0.0.1:0 today). Also live-backend.ts backendOrigin() uses 127.0.0.1, but the built SPA calls http://localhost:3001, so buildLoopbackBackendInventory throws 'unexpected loopback origin' — switch backend origin to localhost so bucketing matches.

SELECTORS: data-test is on the MUI TextField root <div>; the real <input> is nested. Journey page.type('[data-test=signup-first-name]', ...) hits the wrapper; must be '[data-test=signup-first-name] input' for ALL form fields (signup/signin/bank/settings/search). Confirmed nested ids firstName/username etc.

SIGNUP NAV: clicking <a data-test=signup href=/signup> does NOT SPA-navigate under automation (URL stays /signin); a real load of /signup renders SignUpForm. Journey must navigate, not just click [data-test=signup].

BACKEND CATEGORY WRONG: bank-account onboarding uses POST /graphql (200), not POST/GET /bankAccounts. Measured endpoints so far: POST /users, POST /login, GET /transactions/public, GET /notifications, POST /graphql, GET /users. Schema WITNESS_REACT_CYPRESS_RWA_BACKEND_CATEGORY lists /bankAccounts + /users/search which don't match and omits /graphql — needs full re-measurement through payment/feeds/notifications/settings-PATCH and a category rewrite; ROUTES pins also need re-measuring (settings route is /user/settings).

NON-LOOPBACK: app loads avatars from https://cypress-realworld-app-svgs.s3.amazonaws.com/*.svg; the AppSpec declares no transport, so the witness host must mock these (default 204) to keep successfulNonLoopback=0 — needs an explicit transport decision.

MIGRATED BUILD: target/build-vite-run1 (the calibrate driver's 'migrated' root) is an incomplete 6-file copy with no index.html/assets; the complete Vite output is target/build-vite. Lane roots must be corrected before the migrated lane can run.

Where it dies: money-movement submit (POST /transactions), feeds/notifications, settings write, per-pass reseed pass-twice determinism, and the migrated lane are all unproven.
